checks.note: llms-full.txt states MCP uses OAuth 2.1 Authorization Code with PKCE, discovery metadata and dynamic client registration. REST uses API key as Authorization: Bearer, scoped to one organization. OAuth is for third-party/agent API access, not just login. Key issuance page is at consensus.app/subscription/api/ (403 to me).

llms-full.txt shows a Free account works on the MCP server (1 QPS, default 10 papers), plus an anonymous evaluation tier, so the cheapest path to working credentials is self-serve free, not paid_plan. REST key plan requirement is not stated in any fetched page; a search result claims keys are granted after an application, which I could not verify (subscription/api page returned 403).

llms-full.txt describes a REST API exposing search, paper detail, synthesis and Consensus Meter as versioned JSON endpoints. consensus.app/home/mcp mentions GET /v1/search. Narrow breadth is consistent with read-only search. Base URL not stated in fetched pages.

llms-full.txt lists https://mcp.consensus.app/mcp as the vendor's MCP server, with ChatGPT and Claude directory apps wrapping it. The consensus.app/home/mcp page links to Consensus-NLP GitHub and docs.
ready_with_caveats fits: usable via free MCP OAuth today; narrow read-only API; REST key plan/approval unconfirmed; 429 on limits is stated in llms-full.txt.

corrected.one_liner: AI-powered search engine over 400M+ peer-reviewed papers that returns summaries, study metadata, citations and a Consensus Meter of supporting vs. refuting findings.
corrected.auth_notes: Per Consensus's llms-full.txt: the MCP server uses OAuth 2.1 Authorization Code with PKCE and dynamic client registration (recommended for multi-user agents). The REST API uses an API key sent as a bearer token, issued at consensus.app/subscription/api/ and scoped to one organization. There is also an anonymous, heavily rate-limited MCP tier for evaluation. The key-issuance page and docs.consensus.app returned 403, so the issuance flow is unverified.
corrected.access_notes: Cheapest path: MCP via OAuth with a Free account (limited quota, 1 QPS, default 10 papers per search) or the anonymous evaluation tier. REST API: key is scoped to an organization; which plan includes it, and whether it is self-serve or application-based (one third-party source says application/approval), is unverified. Treat REST access as unconfirmed.
corrected.blocker: API is read-only search (search, paper detail, synthesis, Consensus Meter), so narrow. REST key plan/approval status unverified. Free MCP quotas are limited; exceeding limits returns HTTP 429 with Retry-After. Official docs returned 403, so endpoint details and base URL are unconfirmed.
